source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 5 mathematics textbooks

stages.headline: How many endpoints do a segment, a ray and a line have?
stages.headlineEnglish: How many endpoints do a segment, a ray and a line have?
stages.problemText: How many endpoints do a segment, a ray and a line have?
stages.customInstructions: All three numbers 2, 1, 0 are required in this order.

stages.headline: How many lines pass through pairs of 3 points not on one line?
stages.headlineEnglish: How many lines pass through pairs of 3 points not on one line?
stages.problemText: How many lines pass through pairs of 3 points not on one line?
stages.solutionSteps: 1. Pairs AB, AC, BC. 2. Three lines.
stages.solutionStepsEnglish: 1. Pairs AB, AC, BC. 2. Three lines.

stages.headline: At most how many points can two different lines share?
stages.headlineEnglish: At most how many points can two different lines share?
stages.problemText: At most how many points can two different lines share?
stages.solutionSteps: 1. Two common points would make them the same line. 2. At most 1.
stages.solutionStepsEnglish: 1. Two common points would make them the same line. 2. At most 1.

stages.headline: Points A and B are on a line. How many rays on that line start at A or at B?
stages.headlineEnglish: Points A and B are on a line. How many rays on that line start at A or at B?
stages.problemText: Points A and B are on a line. How many rays on that line start at A or at B?
stages.solutionSteps: 1. Two from A, two from B. 2. 4.
stages.solutionStepsEnglish: 1. Two from A, two from B. 2. 4.

stages.headline: At most how many intersection points can 3 lines have?
stages.headlineEnglish: At most how many intersection points can 3 lines have?
stages.problemText: At most how many intersection points can 3 lines have?
stages.solutionSteps: 1. Each pair meets at most once. 2. There are 3 pairs. 3. At most 3 points.
stages.solutionStepsEnglish: 1. Each pair meets at most once. 2. There are 3 pairs. 3. At most 3 points.

stages.headline: Explain how a ray differs from a segment.
stages.headlineEnglish: Explain how a ray differs from a segment.
stages.problemText: Explain how a ray differs from a segment.
stages.correctAnswer: A segment has 2 endpoints, a ray has 1
stages.solutionSteps: 1. A segment has two endpoints. 2. A ray has only a starting point and goes on forever.
stages.solutionStepsEnglish: 1. A segment has two endpoints. 2. A ray has only a starting point and goes on forever.
stages.customInstructions: Accept any correct explanation that a segment has two endpoints and a ray only one (it is endless on one side).
